details: Bitcoin dropped below $60,000 on November 20, 2026, marking its lowest price in about 4.5 months. This decline coincided with record daily outflows from U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs, totaling $582.3 million on November 19, driven primarily by $541.1 million from the iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT). The sustained outflows, reaching $3.47 billion over 12 of the first 14 trading days in November, signal strong selling pressure. The broader cryptocurrency market has been affected by a wave of selling across Wall Street's tech stocks and other risk assets, fueled by concerns over interest rates and elevated valuations.
title: Bitcoin Plunges Below $60K Amid Record ETF Outflows & Risk-Off Sentiment

details: JPMorgan analysts have indicated that Bitcoin's recent price depreciation has widened the gap between its market price and their estimated production cost of $86,000. This widening discrepancy is likely increasing pressure on higher-cost miners to sell their Bitcoin reserves to cover operational expenses, potentially exacerbating selling pressure in the market.
title: JPMorgan: Bitcoin Price Below Production Cost Pressures Miners

details: The AI company Anthropic made its Nasdaq debut on November 19, 2026, with a record-breaking IPO that raised $81.3 billion. This significant event in the tech sector occurred amidst a broad sell-off in tech stocks and cryptocurrencies, with some market participants speculating that capital might be rotating from crypto investments into AI. Bitcoin and other major cryptocurrencies experienced declines, accompanied by substantial liquidations of leveraged positions.
title: Anthropic's Record IPO Coincides with Crypto Market Downturn

details: Coinbase is reportedly planning to launch its own U.S. prediction market contracts by the first half of 2027. This strategic move aims to provide the crypto exchange with greater control over event listings and a larger share of trading revenue. Prediction markets have become a rapidly expanding business for Coinbase, with its current partnership with Kalshi achieving an annualized net revenue run rate exceeding $200 million in Q3 2026.
title: Coinbase to Launch In-House US Prediction Markets by Mid-2027

details: Solana has successfully activated its Alpenglow consensus upgrade, significantly reducing transaction finality times from approximately 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds. The network has also moved past its Mainnet Beta phase. In other developments, Securitize has launched tokenized Anthropic shares on Solana, expanding the blockchain's use cases for tokenized equities. Solana's 2027 roadmap outlines ambitious goals, including doubling computing capacity and reducing token-account transaction costs.
title: Solana's Alpenglow Upgrade Live, Tokenized Shares and 2027 Roadmap Announced

details: Ethereum's upcoming "Glamsterdam" upgrade is facing potential delays, with a new timeline possibly extending to April or May 2027. This consideration arises from compatibility concerns with existing contracts and an ongoing review of gas repricing mechanisms. While the review aims to mitigate potential disruptions, a delay would push back the implementation of planned scaling improvements for the Ethereum network.
title: Ethereum "Glamsterdam" Upgrade Faces Potential Delay to May 2027

details: Cathie Wood's ARK Investment Management has formally requested the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to withdraw the registration statement for its proposed ARK CoinDesk 20 Crypto ETF. The company did not provide a specific reason for abandoning the launch, simply stating that it does not intend to proceed with the planned distribution of the trust's shares.
title: ARK Invest Withdraws CoinDesk 20 Crypto ETF Filing

details: An Abu Dhabi court has issued an order for several major cryptocurrency companies, including Circle and World Liberty Financial, to freeze digital assets worth billions of dollars. This measure is part of ongoing efforts to recover funds from the $6.3 billion worth of tokens stolen from wallets operated by Binance in a hack that occurred on October 29, 2026.
title: Abu Dhabi Court Orders Freeze on Binance-Related Stolen Crypto Tokens
